query:
SELECT fc.colaboradorId, c.nome, fc.mes, fc.ano, fc.totalGeral, fc.totalServicos, fc.totalProdutos 
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc 
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId 
WHERE c.nome = 'Karen' 
ORDER BY fc.ano DESC, fc.mes DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT fc.colaboradorId, c.nome, fc.mes, fc.ano, fc.totalGeral 
FROM faturamentoColaboradores fc 
JOIN colaboradores c ON c.id = fc.colaboradorId 
WHERE fc.mes = 3 AND fc.ano = 2026 AND c.empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote'
ORDER BY fc.totalGeral DESC LIMIT 10;
